Source: UPS Pulse of the Online Shopper
For the fifth year, UPS developed this study with comScore, Inc. Input was
collected from 5,330 qualified comScore panelists in January and February,
2016. Shoppers had to have made at least two online purchases in a typical
month period. To get the full white paper, go to
